claims.claim: Added a bounded deterministic snapshot-only L1 projection with exact TASK selectors, canonical identity-binder reuse, ref/SHA consistency checks and stable source hashes, without retrieval or persistence.

The projection exposes observed durations, token aggregates and family counts with explicit sample, population and missing denominators; absent measurements remain null while observed zero remains zero.
Whole-episode, proof-work, cost, equivalence and comparative-performance gaps carry explicit PARTIAL, UNAVAILABLE or UNKNOWN states without fabricated measurements.
All pre-existing performance-observation function and class definitions remain unchanged; RUN_OBSERVATION and transport implementations are untouched.

Added readiness documentation distinguishing synthetic fixtures from unavailable historical samples, explaining sampling and denominators, preserving VP-01, reusing TASK-326/TASK-328 foundations and enumerating L2/L3/KA-01 prerequisites.
Added regression fixtures for complete, partial, missing and zero inputs, conflicting counters, invalid source identities, bounds, privacy, historical compatibility and external-effect traps.

The committed delta contains only the three authorized files, adds no production call sites or verification/admission/correction behavior, and leaves historical artifacts, R2.1 state, activation and roadmap files unchanged.
